description: This file implements navigation guard functions for browser URL validation, including URL parsing, protocol checks, and policy enforcement for security (e.g., SSRF protection). It defines classes, types, and functions to validate navigation URLs and redirect chains.

classes.name: InvalidBrowserNavigationUrlError
classes.description: Custom error class for invalid navigation URLs.

methods.name: withBrowserNavigationPolicy
methods.description: Creates a policy options object with optional SSRF policy.

methods.name: requiresInspectableBrowserNavigationRedirects
methods.description: Determines if redirects require inspection based on SSRF policy.

methods.name: assertBrowserNavigationAllowed
methods.description: Validates if a given URL is allowed for navigation based on protocol and policy.

methods.name: assertBrowserNavigationResultAllowed
methods.description: Post-navigation check for final URL validity.

methods.name: assertBrowserNavigationRedirectChainAllowed
methods.description: Validates the entire chain of URL redirects for security policy compliance.
